The structure of Dy₃H₆ (reduced formula DyH₂) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6₃/mmc (No. 194), with 9 atoms per unit cell distributed over 2 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies two distinct Dy environments: one with 14 geometric neighbors (6 Dy, 8 H) and another with 8 H neighbors, while H centers show 14 neighbors (10 Dy, 4 H). The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component spanning all 9 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among H 14-vertex polyhedra and between Dy 14-vertex and H 14-vertex polyhedra.
